properties.displayName: Alert Event ASIM filtering parser for AWS GuardDuty
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    hostname_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    username_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    attacktactics_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    attacktechniques_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    threatcategory_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    alertverdict_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventseverity_has_any: dynamic=dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool=false,
    pack: bool=false
) {
    AWSGuardDuty
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | extend
        ActivityTokens = split(ActivityType, ":"),
        AccessKeyDetails = ResourceDetails.accessKeyDetails,
        RdsDbUserDetails = ResourceDetails.rdsDbUserDetails,
        KubernetesDetails = ResourceDetails.kubernetesDetails,
        SeverityScore = todouble(Severity)
    | extend
        ThreatPurpose = tostring(ActivityTokens[0]),
        ActivityRemainder = tostring(ActivityTokens[1])
    | extend
        ResourceTokens = split(ActivityRemainder, "/")
    | extend
        ResourceTypeAffected = tostring(ResourceTokens[0]),
        ThreatFamilyRemainder = tostring(ResourceTokens[1])
    | extend
        ThreatTokens = split(ThreatFamilyRemainder, ".")
    | extend
        ThreatFamilyName = tostring(ThreatTokens[0]),
        DetectionRemainder = tostring(ThreatTokens[1])
    | extend
        DetectionTokens = split(DetectionRemainder, "!")
    | extend
        DetectionMechanism = tostring(DetectionTokens[0]),
        Artifact = tostring(DetectionTokens[1])
    | extend
        ServiceAction = case(
            isnotempty(ServiceDetails.action.awsApiCallAction), ServiceDetails.action.awsApiCallAction,
            isnotempty(ServiceDetails.action.kubernetesApiCallAction), ServiceDetails.action.kubernetesApiCallAction,
            isnotempty(ServiceDetails.action.networkConnectionAction), ServiceDetails.action.networkConnectionAction,
            isnotempty(ServiceDetails.action.rdsLoginAttemptAction), ServiceDetails.action.rdsLoginAttemptAction,
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | extend
        RemoteIpAddress = tostring(coalesce(
            ServiceAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV4,
            ServiceAction.remoteIpDetails.ipAddressV6,
            todynamic(ServiceAction.sourceIPs)[0]
        )),
        LocalIpAddress = tostring(coalesce(
            ServiceAction.localIpDetails.ipAddressV4,
            ServiceAction.localIpDetails.ipAddressV6
        )),
        RemoteAWSAccountId = tostring(ServiceAction.remoteAccountDetails.accountId),
        AccountUpn = tostring(case(
            tostring(AccessKeyDetails.userType) == "IAMUser", AccessKeyDetails.userName,
            tostring(AccessKeyDetails.userType) == "AssumedRole", split(tostring(AccessKeyDetails.principalId), ":", 1)[0],
            isnotempty(RdsDbUserDetails.user), RdsDbUserDetails.user,
            isnotempty(KubernetesDetails.kubernetesUserDetails.username), KubernetesDetails.kubernetesUserDetails.username,
            ""
        ))
    | where (array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0)
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(RemoteIpAddress, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(LocalIpAddress, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    | where (array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0)
    | where (array_length(username_has_any) == 0) or AccountUpn has_any (username_has_any)
    | extend
        FindingLink = iff(
            isnotempty(Region) and isnotempty(Id),
            strcat("https://", Region, ".console.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/home?region=", Region, "#/findings?fId=", Id),
            ""
        )
    | extend
        EventType = "Alert",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventStartTime = TimeCreated,
        EventEndTime = TimeCreated,
        EventUid = Id,
        EventOriginalUid = Id,
        EventProduct = "GuardDuty",
        EventVendor = "AWS",
        EventProductVersion = SchemaVersion,
        EventSchema = "AlertEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1",
        EventMessage = Description,
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(Severity),
        EventSeverity = case(
            SeverityScore >= 7.0, "High",
            SeverityScore >= 4.0 and SeverityScore <= 6.9, "Medium",
            SeverityScore >= 1.0 and SeverityScore <= 3.9, "Low",
            "Informational"
        ),
        EventSubType = "Threat",
        EventOriginalType = ActivityType,
        EventOriginalSubType = DetectionMechanism,
        EventReportUrl = FindingLink,
        AlertName = Title,
        AlertId = Id,
        AlertDescription = Description,
        AlertOriginalStatus = "",
        AlertStatus = "Active",
        AlertVerdict = "Unknown",
        RuleName = ActivityType,
        RuleDescription = Title,
        DetectionMethod = case(
            DetectionMechanism has "ThreatList", "Threat Intelligence",
            DetectionMechanism has "Reputation", "Threat Intelligence",
            DetectionMechanism has "Anomaly", "Behavioral Analytics",
            "Behavioral Analytics"
        ),
        ThreatName = ThreatFamilyName,
        ThreatOriginalCategory = ThreatPurpose,
        ThreatCategory = "Unknown",
        ThreatRiskLevel = toint(Severity),
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel = tostring(Severity),
        IndicatorType = iff(isnotempty(RemoteIpAddress), "Ip", ""),
        DvcIpAddr = LocalIpAddress,
        DvcId = tostring(coalesce(
            ResourceDetails.instanceDetails.instanceId,
            ResourceDetails.eksClusterDetails.name,
            ResourceDetails.ecsClusterDetails.name,
            ResourceDetails.rdsDbInstanceDetails.dbInstanceIdentifier,
            Arn
        )),
        DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        Dvc = DvcId,
        Username = AccountUpn,
        UsernameType = case(
            AccountUpn contains "@", "UPN",
            isnotempty(AccountUpn), "Simple",
            ""
        ),
        UserId = tostring(coalesce(
            AccessKeyDetails.accessKeyId,
            AccessKeyDetails.principalId,
            RemoteAWSAccountId
        )),
        UserIdType = iff(isnotempty(UserId), "Other", ""),
        UserScope = "AWSAccount",
        UserScopeId = AccountId,
        IpAddr = RemoteIpAddress,
        User = AccountUpn,
        Rule = ActivityType,
        Url = FindingLink,
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "Arn", Arn,
                "Partition", Partition,
                "Region", Region,
                "SchemaVersion", SchemaVersion,
                "ThreatPurpose", ThreatPurpose,
                "ResourceTypeAffected", ResourceTypeAffected,
                "DetectionMechanism", DetectionMechanism,
                "Artifact", Artifact,
                "RemoteIpAddress", RemoteIpAddress,
                "LocalIpAddress", LocalIpAddress,
                "RemoteAWSAccountId", RemoteAWSAccountId,
                "ServiceDetails", ServiceDetails,
                "ResourceDetails", ResourceDetails
            ),
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | where (array_length(eventseverity_has_any) == 0) or EventSeverity has_any (eventseverity_has_any)
    | where (array_length(alertverdict_has_any) == 0) or AlertVerdict has_any (alertverdict_has_any)
    | where (array_length(threatcategory_has_any) == 0)
        or ThreatCategory has_any (threatcategory_has_any)
        or ThreatOriginalCategory has_any (threatcategory_has_any)
    | where (array_length(attacktactics_has_any) == 0)
    | where (array_length(attacktechniques_has_any) == 0)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type,
        AdditionalFields,
        AlertDescription,
        AlertId,
        AlertName,
        AlertOriginalStatus,
        AlertStatus,
        AlertVerdict,
        DetectionMethod,
        Dvc,
        DvcId,
        DvcIdType,
        DvcIpAddr,
        EventCount,
        EventEndTime,
        EventMessage,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventProduct,
        EventProductVersion,
        EventReportUrl,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventSeverity,
        EventStartTime,
        EventSubType,
        EventType,
        EventUid,
        EventVendor,
        IndicatorType,
        IpAddr,
        Rule,
        RuleDescription,
        RuleName,
        ThreatCategory,
        ThreatName,
        ThreatOriginalCategory,
        ThreatOriginalRiskLevel,
        ThreatRiskLevel,
        Url,
        User,
        UserId,
        UserIdType,
        Username,
        UsernameType,
        UserScope,
        UserScopeId
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any,
    username_has_any=username_has_any,
    attacktactics_has_any=attacktactics_has_any,
    attacktechniques_has_any=attacktechniques_has_any,
    threatcategory_has_any=threatcategory_has_any,
    alertverdict_has_any=alertverdict_has_any,
    eventseverity_has_any=eventseverity_has_any,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack
)
